entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:1
segments: ¶Remember now your Creator in the days of your youth, Before the difficult days come, And the years draw near when you say, "I have no pleasure in them":

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:2
segments: While the sun and the light, The moon and the stars, Are not darkened, And the clouds do not return after the rain;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:3
segments: In the day when the keepers of the house tremble, And the strong men bow down; When the grinders cease because they are few, And those that look through the windows grow dim;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:4
segments: When the doors are shut in the streets, And the sound of grinding is low; When one rises up at the sound of a bird, And all the daughters of music are brought low;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:5
segments: Also they are afraid of height, And of terrors in the way; When the almond tree blossoms, The grasshopper is a burden, And desire fails. For man goes to his eternal home, And the mourners go about the streets.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:6
segments: [Remember your Creator] before the silver cord is loosed, Or the golden bowl is broken, Or the pitcher shattered at the fountain, Or the wheel broken at the well.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:7
segments: Then the dust will return to the earth as it was, And the spirit will return to God who gave it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:8
segments: ¶"Vanity of vanities," says the Preacher, "All [is] vanity."

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:9
segments: And moreover, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yes, he pondered and sought out [and] set in order many proverbs.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:10
segments: The Preacher sought to find acceptable words; and [what was] written [was] upright-words of truth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:11
segments: The words of the wise are like goads, and the words of scholars are like well-driven nails, given by one Shepherd.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:12
segments: And further, my son, be admonished by these. Of making many books [there is] no end, and much study [is] wearisome to the flesh.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:13
segments: ¶Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God and keep His commandments, For this is man's all.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:14
segments: For God will bring every work into judgment, Including every secret thing, Whether good or evil.
